description: Create a padel match (4 players) or an americano tournament for a person. Returns the share link for the players and the organizer's private links. Give the person all links; keep personalToken and manageUrl private. Ask before creating; one request, one match.

bookingUrl.description: The club's booking page or confirmation link, shown to players.

capacity.description: Tournaments only, a multiple of 4. Matches are always 4.

cost.description: What each player pays, as free text: 400 THB, €8, split 4 ways.

durationMinutes.description: How long the court is booked: 60, 90 or 120 minutes. Omit for 90 (a match) or 120 (a tournament). The match page, the cards and the calendar invitation show it.

format.description: Tournaments only. americano: partners rotate, everyone plays everyone. mexicano: courts by standings after round 1. king: winners move up a court, losers down.

gamesTo.description: Tournaments only: first to N games (4, 6, 8) instead of points; the table then ranks by matches won.

levelMin.description: Level range 0 to 7 (Playtomic-style). Omit both for any level.

listOnVenueBoard.description: Show the match on the public venue board (/v/{venue-slug}). Off by default.

email.description: Optional. Gets the organizer link and calendar invite by email.

token.description: Personal token of an existing Kicksmash player, returned by earlier calls, so the same person organizes again.

organizerPlays.description: Seat the organizer in the match (default). False when they only organize.

pointsPerMatch.description: Tournaments only: fixed points per match (16, 21, 24, 32). Omit for free scoring; mexicano defaults to 24.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time. With an offset or Z it is absolute; without one it is read in tz. Example: 2026-09-11T19:00

type.description: A match is exactly four players. A tournament is an americano with 4 to 64 players in fours.

tz.description: IANA time zone the players live in, for example Asia/Singapore or Asia/Bangkok.

venue.description: Club or court name. Enables the venue board and the booking link.

verifiedLevelsOnly.description: With a range: only levels confirmed by an organizer, a coach or a club walk in; declared levels inside the range ask to join.

name: create_match
title: Create a match
